comparison.objective: Retract an exposed utility-knife blade before stowing the knife.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a small linear slide while respecting blade keep-out space, then place the tool.
comparison.success_condition: Blade fully retracted and knife released at rest in tray, with no premature movement or finger contact near the exposed blade.
comparison.reason: A safety-gated sliding mechanism and stow operation is meaningfully different from impact-driven tang fracture and recovery.
